# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

Stavroula Sokoli holds a PhD in Translation and Interpretation from the Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (2011; thesis: "Subtitling Norms in Greece and Spain"). She is a senior researcher at the Computer Technology Institute and Press "Diophantus" (CTI) in Greece, teaches at the Hellenic Open University and works as an audiovisual translator, subtitling films and series into Greek. Since 2025 she has been doing postdoctoral research at the Hellenic Open University on artificial intelligence in education and audiovisual creation. She is Vice President of the European Association for Studies in Screen Translation (ESIST). She writes in English, Spanish, Greek and Catalan.

Everything in this file also appears on the pages it links to.
